title: Default Filters with Custom Widget

comments.body:
Hi @JonnyTurnerUK sorry for the late response. I believe you are using a custom widget, could you maybe give us the code of the custom widget here?

What may be the source of your issues here is that ultimately you would want to use a "disjunctive facets" that would allow you to not only refine on a facets but keep showing the other facet values.

For this to work, I would advise you to change facets and facetsRefinements to disjunctiveFacets and disjunctiveFacetsRefinements.

The use case of default selected filters is very important to us because more and more frequent. This is today a pain to use and we want to make it easier.

Hi again, do you think you could work into getting a functionnal jsFiddle http://jsfiddle.net/ for us to hack on it? That way, once you have the jsFiddle up and running, and that you can show us the behavior that is not expected. We can easily help you on it.

Thanks a lot for using instantsearch.js
Definitely, I'll work on it now and try and get something asap for you.

@vvo - managed to create something here with the Ikea credentials - https://jsfiddle.net/JonnyTurnerUK/3cjth7s2/5/

In this case, I'm using 'Material' as opposed to 'Make' so therefore, on load, the dropdown should be populated with all other materials with Glass selected within it. Hope this makes sense.

Awesome!!! I tried various types of facets, it turns out that 'Hyundai' should have been 'HYUNDAI' also for it to be selected in the hierarchy too. 

DOH! Thanks a lot for that. Much appreciated.
Great! Clearly this is our fault for now, not being good at this default selected game :) Happy coding

Just wanted to chime in -- hit a brick wall with a similar issue for awhile before discovering this thread. I had `menu` widgets, which when prefiltered were not showing as selected. 

My fix was also to change `facetsRefinements` to `hierarchicalFacetsRefinements`. Even though my facets are not hierarchical. Maybe update [the documentation](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#default-filters) to recommend using `hierarchicalFacetsRefinements` instead?

Thanks!
